card.name: Open parenthesis before section numbers
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after a cross-reference such as "see Drug Interactions" or after a drug name, just before a section number or abbreviation. Also seen on a few odd spots such as "to" in a legal sentence and the digit in a DOI.

modes.label: Cross-reference bracket
modes.description: Parenthesis after "[see Drug Interactions" that leads into a section number like 7 or 7.2.
modes.example: blood concentrations of phenobarbital and/or phenytoin may be affected [see Drug Interactions<< (>>7.2) ].

modes.label: Abbreviation after drug name
modes.description: Parenthesis after a drug name that introduces its abbreviation.

modes.label: Stray cases
modes.description: Odd spots outside drug labels, such as a digit inside a DOI.

card.writes: The promoted tokens (div, sol, tab, inf) hint at short abbreviation-like or markup-like pieces, but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the opening bracket that introduces a section number or abbreviation right after a drug interaction reference.
